snippet.title: The Truth Behind
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Truth Behind – uncovers the hidden face of history — the ruthless, strange, and forgotten truths buried beneath centuries of myth.
From the muddy rations of World War II trenches to the silent hunger of medieval villages, each story exposes how people truly endured, fought, and survived when survival itself was a miracle.

Step into vanished worlds of emperors, soldiers, and ordinary souls — where faith, fear, and fire shaped every life.
If you crave untold history, haunting secrets, and the raw side of the human past that schoolbooks never dared to show — you’ve just found it.

snippet.title: Modern History TV
snippet.description: Jason Kingsley CBE, the Modern Knight, explores the real world of the Middle Ages perfect for fantasy fans, writers, gamers, and creators who want to understand the history behind the swords and castles. We aim to research and test out what it was like for both ordinary people, peasants and townspeople, as well as the nobility like knights and lords. Jason owns and trains his own warhorses, jousts competitively, fights in medieval armour and tests theories practically and sometimes to destruction. Mostly about the historical medieval in England, we occasionally venture into other aspects of history and occasionally fantasy like Lord of the Rings or Dungeons and Dragons. We are a historically researched factual channel useful to writers and gamers as well and people interested in historical documentaries. The aim is to provide accurate, engaging, and evergreen history content for students, teachers, writers, role-players, and anyone curious about how medieval life really worked.

“History Unleashed” takes you on a cinematic journey through the greatest moments of human history. Long-forgotten eras are brought back to life – with epic visuals, documentary realism, and meticulously detailed reconstructions.

Whether it’s legendary battles, forgotten empires, or decisions that changed the course of the world forever – every episode tells history the way it really was: raw, intense, human.

Experience history not as a dry list of dates, but as what it truly is – a chain of courage, fear, power, and fate.

– Historical battles and war-defining decisions
– The rise and fall of great empires
– Biographies of extraordinary individuals
– Untold turning points that shaped our world

snippet.title: Ancestral Survival
snippet.description:
Ancestral Survival is a journey into the ancient ways of living — where fire was crafted by hand, tools were carved from stone, and every day was a test of ingenuity and resilience. Through historical reenactments and primitive technology, we explore how our ancestors endured the harshest conditions with nothing but natural resources and human will.

Learn how to build, cook, and survive the way people did centuries — or even millennia — ago.
Perfect for history lovers, outdoor adventurers, and anyone drawn to the timeless challenge of survival without modern comforts.

snippet.title: What If
snippet.description:
An epic exploration of possibilities. Join Peter and explore science-based hypothetical worlds across space, technology, Earth, and prehistoric history. Each episode begins with a simple “what if” question and follows real scientific theory, physics, biology, and astronomy to see where those ideas could lead.

Travel from deep space and alien planets to future technology and ancient life on Earth, and discover how small changes in science or history could reshape life, civilization, and the universe. It’s a blend of science education, imagination, and real research that helps you see our world, and the cosmos, from a fresh perspective.

snippet.title: Surviving the Past
snippet.description:
Step into the shoes of a Roman soldier, a medieval peasant, or a woman living in the shadows of empires.
This channel explores the brutal, raw, and often forgotten realities of everyday life in ancient times.

How did people eat, sleep, work, survive disease—or childbirth?
What was it really like to live without modern comforts, rights, or medicine?

No kings or heroes — only survival.
Time-travel through the past and find out:
Could you survive?
